sentiment.rationale: The document reports strong first-quarter results with revenue up 19% and GMV up 18%, and management describes the quarter as a 'strong start to the year' with 'performance ahead of expectations.' However, the forward guidance for Q2 2026 implies a significant deceleration in growth (FX-neutral revenue growth of 8%-10% versus 17% in Q1), and the document does not state that prior guidance was raised. The score reflects genuine operational momentum and confident language, but is tempered by the implied deceleration in forward guidance and the absence of an explicit guidance raise.

summary.revenue: $3.1 billion, up 19% on an as-reported basis and up 17% on an FX-Neutral basis.
summary.eps: GAAP EPS of $1.12 per diluted share; Non-GAAP EPS of $1.66 per diluted share.
summary.guidance: Q2 2026 guidance: Revenue $2.97-$3.03 billion (FX-neutral Y/Y growth 8%-10%); GMV $21.3-$21.7 billion (FX-neutral Y/Y growth 8%-10%); Diluted GAAP EPS $1.09-$1.14; Diluted Non-GAAP EPS $1.46-$1.51.
summary.margin: GAAP operating margin decreased to 19.8% from 23.6% year-over-year. Non-GAAP operating margin decreased to 29.4% from 29.6% year-over-year.
key_risks: Pending Depop acquisition subject to regulatory approvals in other markets, including the United Kingdom and Australia.
